record_lifetime_boundaries.rule: slot and generation must both match before returning a reference
remove advances the generation; a u32::MAX generation slot is retired instead of wrapping into an old identity
reset replaces phase and clears rich state; wake state is reset in place only with unique Arc ownership, otherwise replaced
external task table removes and detaches the record before RuntimeState completion; post-lock retirement drops it rather than returning it to the table pool

source_accuracy_findings.recorded_claim: the stable cancellation envelope's Release and Acquire pair itself publishes the cancellation reason
